front: How do you make a lag-7 feature in pandas?
back: s.shift(7). Row t then holds the value from row t − 7. The first 7 rows are NaN.
s.shift(1).rolling(7).mean(). The shift removes the current value from the window.

front: Why is s.rolling(7).mean() unsafe as a feature?
back: Rolling windows are trailing and include the current row, so the target is inside the feature.

front: How to build lags for many series in one table?
back: Use groupby(series_id)[col].shift(k) so lags never cross from one series to another.
Use only information known at the forecast origin; with horizon h, target-relative lags must be at least h.

front: Quick leak test for a feature?
back: Change the target of the last row. If the feature of that row changes, it leaks.
